objectives.title: 解释关系连接基于显式条件及左行多匹配
objectives.description: 解释关系连接根据如customer_id相等的显式条件组合两表行，并说明一个左表行可以匹配多个右表行。
objectives.priorityRationale: 所选证据E6、E2、E45自身信封支持explain构造的正式评估路径
objectives.formalAssessmentReadinessRationale: 当前版本存在已验证且无冲突的精确来源权威。

objectives.title: 推导INNER JOIN与LEFT JOIN结果并处理多匹配与未匹配
objectives.description: 通过取每个左表行、在连接键上查找每个匹配右表行并发射每个对子来推导INNER JOIN和LEFT JOIN结果：INNER在无匹配时不发射，LEFT在无匹配时恰好发射一个带右表列NULL占位符的行；保留多个匹配为独立行，不汇总或去重。
objectives.priorityRationale: 所选证据E15、E21、E27、E23、E7自身信封支持apply构造的正式评估路径
objectives.formalAssessmentReadinessRationale: 当前版本存在已验证且无冲突的精确来源权威。

objectives.title: 选择连接类型并解释NULL占位与不等价性
objectives.description: 当仅请求匹配行时选择INNER JOIN，当需保留某表所有行时将该表置于左侧使用LEFT JOIN；解释NULL占位表示无匹配右表值而非零，并说明即便某案例行数相同，当存在未匹配行时两连接行为不同不可互换。

assessment_attempts.responses: {"assessment_item_ff5c97e0-9c7d-41dd-9ced-6d2447d345e5":"关系连接机制：根据显式条件（如 Authors.author_id = Books.author_id），对左表每一行独立扫描右表所有行；只要右表某行的连接键与左表行相等，就产生一个由两行组合而成的结果行。该过程按配对逐一发射，不自动汇总或合并多个匹配。\n\n基于给定数据：Authors 有 (1,'Lee') 和 (2,'Mo')；Books 有 (101,1,'A')、(102,1,'B')、(103,2,'C')。以 author_id 相等为条件，处理左行 Lee (author_id=1) 时，检查 Books 全部行：book_id=101 的 author_id=1，相等，生成组合行 (Lee,101,'A')；book_id=102 的 author_id=1，相等，生成组合行 (Lee,102,'B')；book_id=103 的 author_id=2，不相等，无配对。因此 Lee 这一个左表行因为右表中存在两行满足键相等，被配对两次，在连接结果中出现两次（例如内连接结果包含 (Lee,101,'A'), (Lee,102,'B'), (Mo,103,'C')）。这正说明一个左表行可以匹配多个右表行，且连接机制不会把这两行合并为单行。"}

concepts.name: 关系连接基本定义
concepts.summary: 关系连接根据指定条件组合两个表中的行。本资料中Customers与Orders通过customer_id匹配，连接操作基于非空的匹配标识符进行。
concepts.grounding: {"blockId":"blk_0_6f502b39","quote":"A relational join combines rows from two tables according to a stated condition.","startOffset":0,"endOffset":80,"occurrenceCount":1,"reanchored":false}

concepts.name: INNER JOIN 语义
concepts.summary: INNER JOIN只返回两表间满足连接条件的匹配行对。不匹配的左表行（如没有订单的客户）不会出现，且连接不会自动汇总多匹配行。
concepts.grounding: {"blockId":"blk_1_ca453a0e","quote":"An INNER JOIN on Customers.customer_id = Orders.customer_id returns one combined row for each matching pair.","startOffset":0,"endOffset":108,"occurrenceCount":1,"reanchored":false}

concepts.name: LEFT JOIN 语义
concepts.summary: LEFT JOIN保留左表每一行。有匹配时返回匹配对；无匹配时为右表列返回NULL占位行，NULL表示无匹配而非零值。
concepts.grounding: {"blockId":"blk_2_e212900e","quote":"A LEFT JOIN preserves every row from its left table.","startOffset":0,"endOffset":52,"occurrenceCount":1,"reanchored":false}

concepts.name: 连接类型选择依据需求
concepts.summary: 应根据任务选择连接：需保留所有客户（含无订单）则左表放Customers用LEFT JOIN；只需实际订单则用INNER JOIN。左表侧决定保留集。
concepts.grounding: {"blockId":"blk_3_12ccbd96","quote":"If the task asks for all customers, including those without orders, Customers should be the preserved side.","startOffset":23,"endOffset":130,"occurrenceCount":1,"reanchored":false}

concepts.name: LEFT JOIN 不自动聚合
concepts.summary: LEFT JOIN不意味着每客户一行：若客户有多个订单，仍产生多个结果行。要获得每客户汇总需额外聚合步骤，不在基础连接内。
concepts.grounding: {"blockId":"blk_3_12ccbd96","quote":"Choosing LEFT JOIN does not imply one row per customer: multiple matches still produce multiple result rows.","startOffset":220,"endOffset":328,"occurrenceCount":1,"reanchored":false}

concepts.name: INNER与LEFT JOIN不等价
concepts.summary: 即使某些数据下两连接结果行数相同，它们也非可互换：当存在无匹配的左表行时行为不同（LEFT保留NULL行，INNER丢弃）。
concepts.grounding: {"blockId":"blk_4_f616928b","quote":"Equality of row counts in this example does not make INNER and LEFT JOIN interchangeable for every dataset; their behavior differs whenever a preserved customer has no match.","startOffset":212,"endOffset":386,"occurrenceCount":1,"reanchored":false}

concepts.name: 连接结果无隐含额外操作
concepts.summary: 构造连接结果是逐行匹配发射，无显式排序指令则结果顺序不保证，且连接本身不隐含过滤、聚合或去重步骤。
concepts.grounding: {"blockId":"blk_5_4da07976","quote":"No filter, aggregation, or duplicate-removal step is implied.","startOffset":440,"endOffset":501,"occurrenceCount":1,"reanchored":false}

material_revisions.content:
A relational join combines rows from two tables according to a stated condition. In this lesson, Customers has columns customer_id and name. Its rows are (1, Ada), (2, Ben), and (3, Cleo). Orders has columns order_id, customer_id, and amount. Its rows are (71, 1, 20), (72, 1, 35), and (73, 3, 10). Customer identifiers uniquely identify customers; one customer can have several orders. All identifiers used for matching are non-null.

An INNER JOIN on Customers.customer_id = Orders.customer_id returns one combined row for each matching pair. Selecting name, order_id, and amount gives (Ada, 71, 20), (Ada, 72, 35), and (Cleo, 73, 10). Ben has no matching order, so Ben does not appear. Ada appears twice because two separate order rows match Ada's customer row. A join does not automatically summarize these into a single row or add their amounts.

A LEFT JOIN preserves every row from its left table. It returns the same matching pairs where matches exist. For a left row with no match, it returns one row with null placeholders for the right-table columns. With Customers on the left, the result additionally contains (Ben, null, null). Null here means no matching order value was supplied. It does not mean Ben placed an order numbered zero with amount zero. The three matching rows are still present, so this LEFT JOIN has four result rows.

The left side matters. If the task asks for all customers, including those without orders, Customers should be the preserved side. If the task asks only for customers' actual orders, the INNER JOIN answers that request. Choosing LEFT JOIN does not imply one row per customer: multiple matches still produce multiple result rows. To obtain totals per customer would require a separate aggregation step, outside this lesson's row-by-row join task.

Consider a new order (74, 2, 8). After adding it, Ben has one match. The customer-preserving LEFT JOIN now includes (Ben, 74, 8), with no null placeholder row for Ben. Both joins have four rows for these tables. Equality of row counts in this example does not make INNER and LEFT JOIN interchangeable for every dataset; their behavior differs whenever a preserved customer has no match.

To work out a result, take each customer row, find every order with the same identifier, and emit each matching pair. For INNER JOIN, emit nothing for an unmatched customer. For LEFT JOIN, emit exactly one placeholder row for that unmatched customer. Check the matching key and the requested output columns. Result row order is not guaranteed without an explicit ordering instruction, so any ordering of the same result rows is valid here. No filter, aggregation, or duplicate-removal step is implied.

source_blocks.content: A relational join combines rows from two tables according to a stated condition. In this lesson, Customers has columns customer_id and name. Its rows are (1, Ada), (2, Ben), and (3, Cleo). Orders has columns order_id, customer_id, and amount. Its rows are (71, 1, 20), (72, 1, 35), and (73, 3, 10). Customer identifiers uniquely identify customers; one customer can have several orders. All identifiers used for matching are non-null.

An INNER JOIN on Customers.customer_id = Orders.customer_id returns one combined row for each matching pair. Selecting name, order_id, and amount gives (Ada, 71, 20), (Ada, 72, 35), and (Cleo, 73, 10). Ben has no matching order, so Ben does not appear. Ada appears twice because two separate order rows match Ada's customer row. A join does not automatically summarize these into a single row or add their amounts.

A LEFT JOIN preserves every row from its left table. It returns the same matching pairs where matches exist. For a left row with no match, it returns one row with null placeholders for the right-table columns. With Customers on the left, the result additionally contains (Ben, null, null). Null here means no matching order value was supplied. It does not mean Ben placed an order numbered zero with amount zero. The three matching rows are still present, so this LEFT JOIN has four result rows.

The left side matters. If the task asks for all customers, including those without orders, Customers should be the preserved side. If the task asks only for customers' actual orders, the INNER JOIN answers that request. Choosing LEFT JOIN does not imply one row per customer: multiple matches still produce multiple result rows. To obtain totals per customer would require a separate aggregation step, outside this lesson's row-by-row join task.

Consider a new order (74, 2, 8). After adding it, Ben has one match. The customer-preserving LEFT JOIN now includes (Ben, 74, 8), with no null placeholder row for Ben. Both joins have four rows for these tables. Equality of row counts in this example does not make INNER and LEFT JOIN interchangeable for every dataset; their behavior differs whenever a preserved customer has no match.

To work out a result, take each customer row, find every order with the same identifier, and emit each matching pair. For INNER JOIN, emit nothing for an unmatched customer. For LEFT JOIN, emit exactly one placeholder row for that unmatched customer. Check the matching key and the requested output columns. Result row order is not guaranteed without an explicit ordering instruction, so any ordering of the same result rows is valid here. No filter, aggregation, or duplicate-removal step is implied.

submissions.answers: [{"questionId":"que_e8e50656-0c69-4309-a543-a41b67dc1564","type":"short_answer","text":"关系连接机制：根据显式条件（如 Authors.author_id = Books.author_id），对左表每一行独立扫描右表所有行；只要右表某行的连接键与左表行相等，就产生一个由两行组合而成的结果行。该过程按配对逐一发射，不自动汇总或合并多个匹配。\n\n基于给定数据：Authors 有 (1,'Lee') 和 (2,'Mo')；Books 有 (101,1,'A')、(102,1,'B')、(103,2,'C')。以 author_id 相等为条件，处理左行 Lee (author_id=1) 时，检查 Books 全部行：book_id=101 的 author_id=1，相等，生成组合行 (Lee,101,'A')；book_id=102 的 author_id=1，相等，生成组合行 (Lee,102,'B')；book_id=103 的 author_id=2，不相等，无配对。因此 Lee 这一个左表行因为右表中存在两行满足键相等，被配对两次，在连接结果中出现两次（例如内连接结果包含 (Lee,101,'A'), (Lee,102,'B'), (Mo,103,'C')）。这正说明一个左表行可以匹配多个右表行，且连接机制不会把这两行合并为单行。"}]
